content.text:
Aspect ratio: 16:9 (the image will be 2048x1152).
Time of day: day
Place: auto (decide from the sketch)
Perspective: auto (follow the sketch; there is no camera sentence).
Image 1: rough sketch by our artist (layout source).
Image 1 with notes: the same picture with the artist's red notes, sent only to you. Note list (positions in % of the picture, x from the left, y from the top):
- text "소파 (빨간색)" at (x 14%, y 71%)
- arrow from (x 46%, y 23%) to (x 49%, y 44%)
- circled or marked area around (x 59%, y 49%), about 12% wide and 14% tall
Style examples: auto mode. Choose up to two from this style library (their small thumbnails follow the input images):
  L1: 학교 앞 횡단보도 (exterior, day)
  L2: 아파트 집 안 (현관에서 본 거실) (interior, day)
  L3: 공원 벤치 (exterior, day)
  L4: 작은 집 방 (소파, 에어컨) (interior, day)
  L5: 아파트 공동현관 (낮) (exterior, day)
  L6: 아파트 공동현관 (밤) (exterior, night)
  L7: 아파트 단지와 거리 (exterior, day)
  L8: 초등학교 교실 (interior, day)
  L9: 나무 아지트 안 (interior, any)
  L10: 공중화장실 (interior, any)
  L11: 공원 정자 (exterior, day)
  L12: 놀이터 (exterior, day)

order.prompt: Generate an image of a cozy apartment living room seen from the entrance. 1. Layout: follow image 1 exactly for the camera, the walls, the window and the sofa on the left. Image 4 shows the target drawing style: a quick freehand brush drawing, like the distant buildings, the white balcony railings, the windows and the trees in image 4. Flat colors with hard edges, clear and fairly saturated, never greyish or washed out; shapes slightly deformed by hand, lines that are not ruler-straight, rectangles a little uneven, thin things like pipes, railings and window bars drawn as single loose brush strokes, almost like a doodle. It must not look wavy or warped. Flat cel shading, no gradients, no glow, no texture, no black outlines. Images 2 and 3 are style examples from our team: follow their flat colors and simple shapes. Trees: each tree's leaves are one to three big solid masses with a simple bumpy outline, in two flat greens with the lighter one on top, like the trees in image 4, not a pattern of many small leaf clusters; a brown trunk with a few thick, loose branch strokes; every tree a little different. Bushes and hedges are low rounded mounds. Time: a clear day. Use a bright, clear daytime palette with fairly strong saturation: clean white and light cream walls, a clear saturated sky blue with a few flat-bottomed white clouds, fresh leaf greens, neutral white balance. Cast shadows are flat, slightly darker shapes. Lamps are off. Light: even and neutral with no direction; no sunbeams, no light patches on the floor or walls, no strong shadows, only small flat contact shadows under objects. Text: no text anywhere. Avoid: sketch lines, labels or handwriting from image 1, ruler-straight vector lines, perfect geometry, wavy distortion, fisheye distortion, black outlines, photorealism, glossy highlights, gradients, soft airbrush, glow, light falloff, light rays, painterly texture, dull greyish or washed-out colors, the playground objects of image 4, the objects, layout or text of the style examples, identical repeated trees, many small leaf clusters, dark shadows, clutter, people. Aspect ratio 16:9.
order.doneMsg: 주문서 완료 · 해석 비용 약 46원. 확인하고 '그림 만들기'를 눌러주세요.
